package rulefixtures

import "errors"

// scenario for errors_new_for_static_sentinel: `errors.New("some error")` called repeatedly in hot paths instead of a package-level sentinel
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

var ErrTimeout = errors.New("operation timed out")
var ErrUnavailable = errors.New("service unavailable")
var ErrRateLimited = errors.New("rate limit exceeded")
var ErrInvalidInput = errors.New("invalid input")

func checkService() error {
	return ErrTimeout
}

func connect() error {
	return ErrUnavailable
}

func validate(data string) error {
	if data == "" {
		return ErrInvalidInput
	}
	return nil
}
